title: The WP Post Author WordPress plugin before 4.2.0 does not check that the account was created before updating its…
description: The WP Post Author WordPress plugin versions prior to 4.2.0 contain a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify that a user account was created before allowing profile updates during front-end registration. This flaw permits unauthenticated users to overwrite the display name, nickname, and website fields of the first user account, which is typically the administrator account.
